name: ${mod_name}
description: Extra cosmetic forms for Cobblemon. Backrooms (Still Life copies, Yellow Carpet), Thanksgiving (harvest colours, Pumpkin Pie) Halloween (animated gore and body horror, Carved Pumpkin) and Christmas (Santa Snorlax, tree Turtwig, gift Trubbish, Krampus Phantump and twinkling lights, Snowball) forms for 72 whole evolutionary lines. Put the item in a supported Pokémon's cosmetic slot.
